About

Gridline was founded in 2019 by two power-systems engineers who met at a network operator. Today we are a team of 48 employees in London and Rotterdam.

Impact

Every connection we unlock is a heat pump or EV charger that replaces a gas boiler or a petrol car. We estimate 95,000 tCO2e avoided per year using our own methodology.
